title: R code for RI-CLPM analyses of desistance correlates in the Pathways to Desistance study (ICPSR 29961)
description: R scripts that build the annual person-year analysis file from the Pathways to Desistance public-use data (ICPSR 29961, Version 2) and reproduce every table, figure and simulation in the accompanying manuscript and its Online Resource 1. The main models are random-intercept cross-lagged panel models (RI-CLPMs) fitted in lavaan for ages 16 to 23, with maximum-likelihood dynamic panel models, multivariate RI-CLPMs and three simulation studies as checks. The ICPSR data are not included (ICPSR terms of use); the reference_outputs folder holds summary estimates only.
